title: Zephyr: EUI-64 U/L bit flip
close_reason: Verified the Zephyr C path already implements RFC 4291 Modified EUI-64 as an exact first-octet U/L-bit XOR (0x02), including safe in-place conversion. Added focused canonical ipv6-addresses.json boundary tests for clear-to-set, set-to-clear, all-zero/all-one, unchanged remaining octets, input preservation, in-place operation, and NULL/error atomicity. Sanitized host C test passed 1/1; canonical Python address/vector tests passed 67; cppcheck and diff check passed. No production edit was needed.
